the game using `alfworld-step 'EXACT ACTION'`, choosing actions from the current
admissible commands. Use the returned observations to track your inventory and
progress. Stop as soon as the environment reports success or termination.

{"principle": "When retrieving items from a room, visiting a receptacle location does not guarantee access; execute go first then check observation for 'closed' state, and only proceed to open if access is blocked or required to verify content. Skips this cycle for open receptacles directly containing the target.", "title": "Disambiguate closed receptacles before open inspection", "when_to_apply": "Any goal requiring retrieval or examination within a room that involves potentially closed cabinets, drawers, or fake doors."}

[Skill skill-27cae2c86808caa0ec1af0ccba7738fb2cb79f04@673770857a23c92a9e0b35d865fc133f77b35bff6e79f45e723ceccea4991edf]
{"principle": "When unable to locate an object immediately, systematically search all drawers and cabinets while tracking visited locations. If the object is found in an openable container, attempt to open it; if it is not found inside, inspect available sinks for objects to clean. After cleaning an object, move it to a nearby openable container and close it, avoiding unnecessary travel back and forth by consolidating movements.", "title": "Coordinated Search and Clean Then Retrieve", "when_to_apply": "The goal type is to retrieve and place a clean version of an indeterminate-assigned object (such as a knife or plate) in a specific location. The object is located in an openable container (drawer, cabinet) that may require opening before retrieval, and the environment may contain multiple identical objects or objects requiring cleaning to meet the goal."}
